  report_date: "2025-01-01"

  status: "Public example"
  confidentiality: "Synthetic data only"
  note: "Demonstration report using synthetic data only."
  data_dir: "code_examples/example_data"
  data_file: "synthetic_dad.xlsx"
  include_summary: true
  include_data_overview: true
  include_appendix: false
  show_code: false

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = isTRUE(params$show_code),
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  out.width = "100%"
)

# Small helpers shared by the whole report.
is_filled <- function(x) {
  length(x) == 1L && !is.na(x) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  isTRUE(x) || (is.character(x) && tolower(x) %in% c("true", "yes", "1"))
}

report_datasets <- list()
data_sources <- character()
data_aliases <- character()
data_notes <- character()

find_project_dir <- function(start_dir) {
  current_dir <- normalizePath(start_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

  repeat {
    r_projects <- list.files(
      current_dir,
      pattern = "\\.[Rr]proj$",
      full.names = TRUE
    )

    if (length(r_projects) > 0L || dir.exists(file.path(current_dir, ".git"))) {
      return(current_dir)
    }

    parent_dir <- dirname(current_dir)
    if (identical(parent_dir, current_dir)) {
      stop("Could not locate the project root.", call. = FALSE)
    }

    current_dir <- parent_dir
  }
}

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
input_dir <- if (nzchar(input_file)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
} else {
  getwd()
}
project_dir <- find_project_dir(input_dir)
data_dir_display <- params$data_dir
source(
  file.path(project_dir, "code_examples", "example_helpers.R"),
  local = TRUE
)

if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  data_notes <- paste(
    "Loading the example workbook requires the 'readxl' package.",
    "Run 'Rscript code_examples/setup_dependencies.R' first."
  )
} else if (is_filled(params$data_dir)) {
  expanded_data_dir <- path.expand(params$data_dir)
  is_absolute_data_dir <- grepl(
    "^(?:/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|\\\\\\\\)",
    expanded_data_dir
  )
  resolved_data_dir <- if (is_absolute_data_dir) {
    expanded_data_dir
  } else {
    file.path(project_dir, expanded_data_dir)
  }
  data_dir <- normalizePath(
    resolved_data_dir,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = FALSE
  )
  project_prefix <- paste0(project_dir, "/")
  data_dir_display <- if (startsWith(data_dir, project_prefix)) {
    substring(data_dir, nchar(project_prefix) + 1L)
  } else {
    "[external data directory]"
  }

  if (dir.exists(data_dir)) {
    data_files <- file.path(data_dir, params$data_file)

    if (!file.exists(data_files)) {
      data_notes <- paste(
        "The DAD data file was not found:",
        file.path(data_dir_display, params$data_file)
      )
    } else {
      # This memo is DAD-only. Load the selected workbook and expose it as
      # both imported_data_001 and the source-based alias dad.
      report_datasets <- tryCatch(
        stats::setNames(
          list(
            read_example_xlsx(data_files)
          ),
          "imported_data_001"
        ),
        error = function(error) {
          data_notes <<- paste(
            "The DAD example workbook could not be loaded.",
            "Check that it is a valid XLSX file."
          )
          list()
        }
      )

      if (length(report_datasets) == 1L) {
        list2env(report_datasets, envir = knitr::knit_global())
        data_sources <- stats::setNames(data_files, names(report_datasets))

        # Create the source-based alias: synthetic_dad.xlsx -> dad.
        data_aliases <- local({
          alias_names <- tolower(
            tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(data_files))
          )
          alias_names <- sub("^(pseudo|synthetic)[._ -]*", "", alias_names)
          alias_names <- make.names(alias_names, unique = TRUE)

          alias_datasets <- stats::setNames(
            unname(report_datasets),
            alias_names
          )
          list2env(alias_datasets, envir = knitr::knit_global())

          stats::setNames(alias_names, names(report_datasets))
        })
      }
    }
  } else {
    data_notes <- paste("Data directory not found:", data_dir_display)
  }
}
```

```{r report-metadata, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
metadata <- c(
  Memo = params$memo,
  Client = params$client,
  `Client Organization` = params$client_organization,
  Version = params$version,
  Status = params$status,
  Classification = params$confidentiality
)
metadata <- metadata[vapply(metadata, is_filled, logical(1))]

if (length(metadata)) {
  items <- paste0(
    '<div class="meta-item"><span class="meta-label">',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(names(metadata)),
    '</span><span class="meta-value">',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(unname(metadata)),
    '</span></div>',
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  cat('<div class="report-meta">', items, '</div>')
}

if (is_filled(params$note)) {
  cat(
    '<div class="report-note"><strong>Note:</strong> ',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(params$note),
    '</div>'
  )
}
```

```{r executive-summary-content, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (as_flag(params$include_summary)) {
  cat("## Introduction\n\n")
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<p>The purpose of this memo is to summarize selected variables from ',
      'the <strong>DAD</strong> data. It provides a concise description of ',
      'the data source and presents descriptive statistics for the selected ',
      'continuous and categorical variables.</p>',
      '<p>The memo is organized as follows:</p>',
      '<ul>',
      '<li><strong>Data</strong> identifies the source file and data directory, ',
      'reports the number of records and variables, lists all available ',
      'variables, and provides a preview of the data.</li>',
      '<li><strong>Main Analysis</strong> summarizes the selected continuous ',
      'variables using measures of central tendency, variability, percentiles, ',
      'and missingness. Selected categorical variables are summarized using ',
      'counts and percentages for each category.</li>',
      if (as_flag(params$include_appendix)) {
        paste0(
          '<li><strong>Appendix</strong> contains supporting information and ',
          'basic reproducibility details.</li>'
        )
      } else {
        ""
      },
      '</ul>'
    )
  )
}
```

```{r data-overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (as_flag(params$include_data_overview)) {
  cat("## Data\n\n")
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<div class="data-disclaimer"><strong>Training data notice:</strong> ',
      'The DAD data used in this memo are randomly generated synthetic data ',
      'intended solely for training and demonstration purposes. They do not ',
      'represent real patients or actual operational records.</div>'
    )
  )

  if (length(report_datasets) > 0L) {
    overview <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(names(report_datasets), function(dataset_name) {
        dataset <- report_datasets[[dataset_name]]
        is_tabular <- is.data.frame(dataset) || is.matrix(dataset)

        data.frame(
          Dataset = dataset_name,
          Alias = data_aliases[[dataset_name]],
          File = basename(data_sources[[dataset_name]]),
          Rows = if (is_tabular) nrow(dataset) else NA_integer_,
          Columns = if (is_tabular) ncol(dataset) else NA_integer_,
          Class = paste(class(dataset), collapse = ", "),
          check.names = FALSE
        )
      })
    )

    cat("**Data directory:** `", data_dir_display, "`\n\n", sep = "")
    print(knitr::kable(overview, caption = "Loaded DAD data set"))
    cat("\n")

    data_variable_names <- names(report_datasets[[1L]])
    variable_items <- paste0(
      '<li><code>',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(data_variable_names),
      '</code></li>',
      collapse = ""
    )
    cat(
      '<div class="data-variable-heading"><strong>Variables (',
      length(data_variable_names),
      ')</strong></div>',
      '<ol class="data-variable-list">',
      variable_items,
      '</ol>',
      sep = ""
    )
    cat("\n")

  } else {
    cat(
      '<p class="placeholder">No data sets were loaded from <code>',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(data_dir_display),
      '</code>.</p>',
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  if (length(data_notes) > 0L) {
    cat("### Data-loading notes\n\n")
    cat(
      paste0(
        "- ",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(data_notes),
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n"
    )
  }
}
```

# Analysis

## DAD Selected Variables

```{r dad-selected-variable-summaries, include=FALSE}
dad_continuous <- c(
  "age_at_admission",
  "cci_score",
  "resource_intensity_weight",
  "acute_los_days",
  "alc_days",
  "icu_hours"
)

dad_categorical <- c(
  "health_zone",
  "sex",
  "postal_fsa",
  "admission_category",
  "admission_source",
  "most_responsible_diagnosis",
  "comorbidity_1",
  "comorbidity_2",
  "comorbidity_3",
  "comorbidity_4",
  "comorbidity_5",
  "intervention_1",
  "intervention_2",
  "intervention_3",
  "intervention_4",
  "case_mix_group",
  "mcc_flag",
  "icu_flag",
  "surgery_flag",
  "transfusion_flag",
  "readmission_30d_flag",
  "discharge_disposition",
  "discharge_destination",
  "attending_service",
  "entry_code",
  "newborn_flag",
  "palliative_flag",
  "death_flag"
)

dad_continuous_summary <- data.frame()
dad_categorical_summary <- data.frame()
dad_summary_notes <- character()

dad_variable_check <- data.frame(
  Variable = c(dad_continuous, dad_categorical),
  Type = c(
    rep("Continuous", length(dad_continuous)),
    rep("Categorical", length(dad_categorical))
  ),
  Available = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (!exists("dad", inherits = TRUE) || !is.data.frame(dad)) {
  dad_summary_notes <- paste(
    "The DAD summary was not generated because the `dad` data set",
    "was not loaded as a data frame."
  )
} else {
  dad_variable_check$Available <-
    dad_variable_check$Variable %in% names(dad)

  available_continuous <- intersect(dad_continuous, names(dad))
  available_categorical <- intersect(dad_categorical, names(dad))
  missing_variables <- dad_variable_check$Variable[
    !dad_variable_check$Available
  ]

  if (length(missing_variables) > 0L) {
    dad_summary_notes <- c(
      dad_summary_notes,
      paste(
        "Variables not found in DAD:",
        paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  continuous_rows <- lapply(available_continuous, function(variable) {
    tryCatch(
      summarize_continuous(
        dataset = dad,
        var_name = variable,
        display_name = variable
      ),
      error = function(error) {
        dad_summary_notes <<- c(
          dad_summary_notes,
          paste0(
            "Continuous variable `", variable,
            "` could not be summarized: ", conditionMessage(error)
          )
        )
        NULL
      }
    )
  })
  continuous_rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), continuous_rows)

  if (length(continuous_rows) > 0L) {
    dad_continuous_summary <- do.call(rbind, continuous_rows)
    rownames(dad_continuous_summary) <- NULL
  }

  categorical_rows <- lapply(available_categorical, function(variable) {
    tryCatch(
      {
        wide_summary <- summarize_categorical(
          dataset = dad,
          var_name = variable,
          display_name = variable,
          include_missing = TRUE,
          sort_levels = "desc"
        )

        data.frame(
          Variable = variable,
          Category = names(wide_summary)[-1L],
          `Count n (%)` = as.character(unlist(
            wide_summary[1L, -1L, drop = FALSE],
            use.names = FALSE
          )),
          check.names = FALSE
        )
      },
      error = function(error) {
        dad_summary_notes <<- c(
          dad_summary_notes,
          paste0(
            "Categorical variable `", variable,
            "` could not be summarized: ", conditionMessage(error)
          )
        )
        NULL
      }
    )
  })
  categorical_rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), categorical_rows)

  if (length(categorical_rows) > 0L) {
    dad_categorical_summary <- do.call(rbind, categorical_rows)
    rownames(dad_categorical_summary) <- NULL
  }
}
```

```{r dad-selected-variable-tables, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (exists("dad", inherits = TRUE) && is.data.frame(dad)) {
  cat(
    "Selected ", length(dad_continuous), " continuous and ",
    length(dad_categorical), " categorical variables from **dad** ",
    "(`", nrow(dad), "` records).\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

if (nrow(dad_continuous_summary) > 0L) {
  cat("### Continuous-Variable \n\n")
  cat('<div class="table-scroll">')
  print(
    local({
      display_summary <- dad_continuous_summary[
        ,
        setdiff(
          names(dad_continuous_summary),
          c("NonFinite", "Analyzed")
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      column_labels <- names(display_summary)
      column_labels[column_labels == "Mean_SD"] <- "Mean (SD)"
      column_labels[column_labels == "Min_Max"] <- "Min–Max"
      column_labels[column_labels == "NonMissing"] <- "Non-missing"
      column_labels[column_labels == "MissingPct"] <- "Missing %"

      knitr::kable(
        display_summary,
        format = "html",
        col.names = column_labels,
        align = c(
          "l",
          rep("r", ncol(display_summary) - 1L)
        ),
        table.attr = 'class="summary-table continuous-summary-table"',
        caption = "Selected DAD continuous variables"
      )
    })
  )
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}

if (nrow(dad_categorical_summary) > 0L) {
  cat("### Categorical-Variable \n\n")
  cat(
    paste0(
      "Each selected variable is shown in its own subsection. Tables with ",
      "many categories are vertically scrollable. Rows labelled ",
      "**Missing** represent original `NA` values; their counts and ",
      "percentages are highlighted in yellow for visibility.\n\n"
    )
  )

  for (variable in dad_categorical) {
    variable_summary <- dad_categorical_summary[
      dad_categorical_summary$Variable == variable,
      c("Category", "Count n (%)"),
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    rownames(variable_summary) <- NULL

    missing_row <- !is.na(variable_summary$Category) &
      variable_summary$Category == "Missing"
    variable_summary$Category <- as.character(
      htmltools::htmlEscape(variable_summary$Category)
    )
    variable_summary[["Count n (%)"]] <- as.character(
      htmltools::htmlEscape(variable_summary[["Count n (%)"]])
    )
    variable_summary$Category[missing_row] <- paste0(
      '<span class="missing-category">Missing</span>',
      '<span class="missing-na-badge">NA</span>'
    )

    if (nrow(variable_summary) > 0L) {
      variable_title <- toupper(gsub("_", " ", variable))
      card_class <- if (nrow(variable_summary) > 20L) {
        "category-table-card long-table"
      } else {
        "category-table-card"
      }

      cat("#### ", variable_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
      cat(
        '<div class="variable-code"><code>',
        htmltools::htmlEscape(variable),
        '</code></div>'
      )
      cat('<div class="', card_class, '">', sep = "")
      print(
        knitr::kable(
          variable_summary,
          format = "html",
          escape = FALSE,
          row.names = FALSE,
          align = c("l", "r"),
          table.attr = 'class="summary-table categorical-summary-table"'
        )
      )
      cat("</div>\n\n")
    }
  }
}

if (length(dad_summary_notes) > 0L) {
  cat("### Summary notes\n\n")
  cat(
    paste0(
      "- ",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(dad_summary_notes),
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}
```
